items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Then there was Guy Kelly, this was my friend. Fabulous young friend from Baton Rouge.

ctx.x: He was in that age bracket. Then there was Louis, then there was Guy Kelly, this was my friend. Fabulous young friend from Baton Rouge. He was very much on the way as much as Louis but he didn‟t…
Really, but he didn‟t quite make it.
